# Statements {.unnumbered}

**Use of AI tools.** This study was carried out with Claude, a language model made by Anthropic, running in Claude Code. Under the author's direction, Claude wrote the code, ran the analyses, drafted the pre-registration (with the open points and a proposed resolution of each, which the author decided at the sign-off, [Appendix @sec-app-prereg]) and this paper, and ran the reviews; separate model instances implemented and reviewed the work. The author set the research question and the hypotheses, signed off the pre-registration, approved every deviation from it ([Appendix @sec-app-deviations]) and takes responsibility for the content. Every reported estimate, count, interval and decision in the paper is generated from the results files by the code of the replication package ([Appendix @sec-app-replication]) and not typed; only rounded verbal comparisons, such as "about a thousandth" or "an order of magnitude", are written by hand. The confirmatory decisions were fixed by the tagged protocol and its coded rules before the runs they read existed (@sec-prereg), not by the assistant's judgement afterwards. The networks studied are small transformers trained from scratch for this study; no model of Anthropic's or of any other developer is a subject of it, and Anthropic did not fund, review or approve this study.

<!-- AUTHOR: confirm -->
**Declaration of interests.** The author has no employment, funding, consulting or equity relationship with Anthropic, OpenAI or any other AI developer, or with the cloud provider used, and has no financial interest in the results.

<!-- AUTHOR: confirm -->
**Funding.** The study received no grant or institutional funding. The rented compute, about \${{< var cost.total_usd >}} to \${{< var cost.total_with_pilot_usd >}} depending on whether the pilot instance was billed separately (not yet reconciled against the provider's bill), was paid from a student cloud credit held by the author; the provider of that credit had no role in the design, the analysis or the decision to publish.

**Licences and data.** The code is released under the {{< var meta.licence.code >}} and the text, results and figures under {{< var meta.licence.text >}}. The data keep their sources' terms: the two small files in `data/` are derived from the Survey of Professional Forecasters and the Real-Time Data Set for Macroeconomists of the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, from FRED, and from the replication package of @afrouzi2023overreaction, of which only six rows of summary statistics are redistributed ([Appendix @sec-app-replication]). All confirmatory data are simulated by the code.

**Data and code availability.** The repository [{{< var meta.repo_short >}}]({{< var meta.repo_url >}}) holds the code, the pre-registration and its tags, the decisions log, the evaluation files behind every verdict and the generator of this paper. The Zenodo DOI {{< var meta.doi >}} is reserved; this paper will be that record.
